caption: The drawing depicts a single, metallic tool resembling a pair of pliers or pincers, positioned horizontally against a plain, off-white background. The tool is rendered in shades of dark gray and brown, giving it a somewhat aged and worn appearance. It features two long, slightly curved handles that cross each other and are joined near the center by a circular pivot, allowing the jaws at the opposite end to open and close. The jaws are roughly rectangular in shape with a notch visible on the upper edge and a hole on the lower jaw. The composition is simple, with the object centered and no other elements present in the image.
